contract.routes: Administrator-only GET and PUT /auth/admin/session-policy. PUT exact revision,idle_ttl_seconds,absolute_ttl_seconds; extra fields forbidden. Revision mismatch400; strict bounded integers.
contract.ranges: Idle600–2592000 seconds; absolute covers idle and is at most31536000 seconds. The minimum idle interval exceeds the fixed5minute access/refresh cadence.
contract.existing_devices: Existing device rows retain the minimum idle/absolute caps ever assigned. Reductions durably tighten current rows and revoke now-expired sessions. Increases apply only to new sign-ins/pairings; no old SID is widened or resurrected.
contract.transports: Current resolve, refresh, background execution, live socket admission/output, pairing sponsorship and unlock use the same current policy. Access JWT expiry is clamped to live device deadline. refresh_expires_in reports remaining immutable absolute lifetime; refresh/CSRF cookies use it rather than reset to default30days. Native/mobile receive the same bearer response without changing their stored principal/scopes.
contract.frontend: Separate SessionPolicyManager child uses admin Access wiring by root. Exact CAS and current revision conflict review; dirty values survive Lock/unlock and unmount responses are fenced.
